budgeting.views

HTTP views: authentication, dashboard, CRUD flows, and reports.

budgeting.views.signup(request)[source]

Show signup form; on POST create user, log in, redirect to dashboard.

class budgeting.views.UserLoginView(**kwargs)[source]

Bases: LoginView

Login page using budgeting/login.html.

Constructor. Called in the URLconf; can contain helpful extra keyword arguments, and other things.

template_name = 'budgeting/login.html'
redirect_authenticated_user = True
budgeting.views.dashboard(request)[source]

Main dashboard: charts, heatmap, health score, budgets, voice quick-add.

budgeting.views.transaction_add(request)[source]

GET: empty form. POST: save income/expense and surface budget alerts.

budgeting.views.transaction_list(request)[source]

Filterable, paginated list with per-filter income/expense totals.

budgeting.views.transaction_edit(request, pk)[source]

Edit an existing transaction owned by the current user.

budgeting.views.transaction_delete(request, pk)[source]

Confirm on GET; POST deletes the transaction.

budgeting.views.category_list(request)[source]

List global default categories and the user’s custom ones; POST adds custom.

budgeting.views.subscription_list(request)[source]

All subscriptions for the logged-in user.

budgeting.views._subscription_save_message(request, saved_verb: str)[source]

After save, post any due subscription expenses and surface one clear toast.

budgeting.views.subscription_add(request)[source]

Create subscription; may immediately post due charges.

budgeting.views.subscription_edit(request, pk)[source]

Update subscription; may post catch-up charges after save.

budgeting.views.subscription_delete(request, pk)[source]

Confirm on GET; POST removes the subscription row only (not past transactions).

budgeting.views.subscription_toggle(request, pk)[source]

Pause or resume automatic posting (POST only).

budgeting.views.budget_list(request)[source]

Budget cards for the user.

budgeting.views.budget_create(request)[source]

Show budget form; POST validates and saves.

budgeting.views.budget_edit(request, pk)[source]

Edit budget limits and dates for one row.

budgeting.views.goals_list(request)[source]

Savings goals overview.

budgeting.views.goal_create(request)[source]

Create a new SavingsGoal.

budgeting.views.goal_contribute(request, pk)[source]

Add money toward a goal; may emit a completion notification.

budgeting.views.reports(request)[source]

Date-range report with category breakdown and simple narrative insights.

budgeting.views.notifications_view(request)[source]

List all notifications and mark unread ones as read.
